verified_facts.text: The resort stands on a 74,000-square-meter private peninsula in St. Julian's, fringed by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: on a private 74,000m² peninsula in St. Julian’s, one of Malta’s most vibrant towns

verified_facts.text: The resort is reached through a private gateway inscribed with Virgil's proverb, God made this gem for us.
verified_facts.excerpt: is accessed via a private gateway, inscribed with Virgil's thoughtful proverb, God made this gem for us

verified_facts.text: The grounds are landscaped around age-old artefacts, sunken gardens and pools, with ocean views throughout.
verified_facts.excerpt: Landscaped around age-old artefacts, sunken gardens and impressive pools, our 5-star hotel in St Julian's, Malta, has stunning ocean views throughout.

verified_facts.text: The villa-style lobby has floor-to-ceiling windows and a sun-drenched terrace overlooking the coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The villa-style lobby is naturally light where floor-to-ceiling windows and a sun-drenched terrace overlook the unspoiled coastline.

verified_facts.text: Most rooms and suites have views of the St. Julian's coastline and the Mediterranean from at least one private balcony or terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: offer spectacular views of the St. Julian's coastline and Mediterranean Sea from at least one private balcony or terrace

verified_facts.text: Luxury Bay Suites sit in their own private annex right on the water's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxury Bay Suites which are located in their own private annex, adjacent to the main hotel, right on the water’s edge

verified_facts.text: Luxury Bay Suites have a kitchenette, a walk-in rain shower, a free-standing bathtub and two private terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: a fully equipped kitchenette, spacious en-suite with walk-in rain shower and free-standing bathtub, mood lighting, sofa bed, 2 private terraces and a guest bathroom

verified_facts.text: Luxury Bay Suites are inspired by the hues of Maltese limestone and the turquoise of the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the soft hues of Maltese limestone and turquoise of the Mediterranean Sea

verified_facts.text: The top-floor Presidential Penthouse Suites feature artworks by local artist Pawl Carbonaro.
verified_facts.excerpt: including handpicked artworks by renowned local artist Pawl Carbonaro

verified_facts.text: The Boathouse Lounge is set in a 19th-century boathouse on the water's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in a 19th-century boathouse on the water's edge, this exclusive lounge offers refined cuisine with fine wines and champagne.

verified_facts.text: Quadro is the flagship restaurant, serving simple homemade dishes with fresh local produce.
verified_facts.excerpt: Quadro, the flagship restaurant at The Westin Dragonara Resort, serves simple, homemade dishes using fresh local produce.

verified_facts.text: The Dragonara casino is in a 19th-century palace built by the Marquis Scicluna, with a colonnaded veranda that meets the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Dragonara casino is housed in a magnificent 19th-century palace, built by the Marquis Scicluna, with a surrounding colonnaded veranda that abuts directly onto the sea

verified_facts.text: Divewise Malta, a dive school for recreational and technical divers, is on the resort grounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Divewise Malta is located on the grounds of The Westin Dragonara Resort, which caters to both recreational and technical divers.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a heated indoor pool and the heated outdoor Bay View Pool.
The Westin Family Kids Club is for ages 3 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open daily from 9am–5pm for ages 3–12, the Westin Family Kids Club offers engaging activities

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments include aromatherapy, stone therapy, candle massage and couple's massage, and in-room treatments can be booked 48 hours ahead.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aromatherapy, Stone therapy, candle massage, body scrub / wrap, and Couple’s massage

verified_facts.text: Malta International Airport and Valletta are a 20-minute drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Malta International Airport & the capital Valletta are only a 20 minute drive from the Resort.

verified_facts.text: The Reef Club Pool is closed from November to April.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reef Club Pool (Closed from November to April) (Outdoor)

verified_facts.text: Despite its vast grounds, the resort is within walking distance of the centre.
